messages:
Priya Malhotra: FYI customer (AcmePayments) reports 503s + huge latency since ~2026-03-17T10:23Z. They say traffic should stay in eu-west-1 but responses are from us-east. Ticket #8672. Escalating to SRE.
Customer - AcmePayments: seeing repeated 503 and timeouts. Our requests are routed to us-east and checkout fails.
Sanjay Rao: I'm pulling the healthcheck logs now and routing table. Can you paste client request ID / sample trace?
Priya Malhotra: sent trace id ab12-ff34 in DM. Headers show x-region: eu-west-1 but x-served-region: us-east-1.
Monitoring Bot: :rotating_light: Alert: healthcheck eu-west-1 failed (3/3) at 2026-03-17T10:22:58Z. Automated failover engaged to fallback pool (us-east-1).
Elena Chen: grabbing agent logs from eu-west nodes. Quick snippet:
```
/var/log/heartbeats/agent.log
2026-03-17T10:22:54Z INFO  heartbeat sent to 52.15.10.9
2026-03-17T10:22:55Z WARN  ack timeout 1200ms
2026-03-17T10:22:56Z ERROR signature verification failed (expected sig-v1)
2026-03-17T10:22:57Z INFO  heartbeat sent to 3.5.210.44
2026-03-17T10:22:58Z ERROR no ack from probe
```
Elena Chen: healthcheck config on those hosts still lists only the old probe IPs: 
```
healthchecks:
  probe_ips: [52.15.10.9]  # expected list, never updated
  threshold_miss: 3
  grace_period_ms: 500
```
Tomás Rivera: we did an IP rotation for probe infrastructure last night (CA-2026 IP hygiene) and updated the central config, but looks like the edge heartbeat-agent didn't pick up the new probe IPs on the eu-west pool. Some hosts are still using the old whitelist so probes from 3.5.210.0/24 get rejected.
Sanjay Rao: that explains false negatives -> healthcheck misses -> automatic failover. Can we apply a temporary allow for the new probe ASN and increase grace window?
Elena Chen: yep. Applying temporary ACL for 3.5.210.0/24 and bumping grace_period_ms to 1200 on eu-west agents. Rolling restart started on pool (eu-west-pool-2).
Tomás Rivera: deployed ACL update and agent restart command: `for node in $(list-eu-west-nodes); do ssh $node 'sudo systemctl restart heartbeat-agent'; done`
Sanjay Rao: monitoring watch on. Also patched signature verification check to accept sig-v2 for legacy probe transients.
Monitoring Bot: Notice: eu-west-1 healthcheck recovered at 2026-03-17T10:39:02Z. Failover reversed.
Priya Malhotra: told customer ETA ~20m and that we rolled them back to eu-west. They asked for root cause and credit.
Customer - AcmePayments: confirmed traffic back to eu-west, checkout working again. Thank you.
Tomás Rivera: root cause summary: probe IP rotation + stale local agent config + strict sig enforcement -> false-negative healthchecks -> automated failover.
Tomás Rivera: immediate fixes: 1) temporary ACL for probe ASN 3.5.210.0/24, 2) increased grace window for eu-west pool, 3) restart heartbeat-agent on all affected hosts.
Sanjay Rao: followups (postmortem items):
- ENG-IR-129: add probe-IP-rotation runbook and preflight checklist
- ENG-OPS-452: agent auto-discovery of central probe list + fallback to DNS names instead of hard IPs
- TEST-784: add synthetic regional-header check to CI to catch region-sticky routing
Elena Chen: scheduled a small agent release that will auto-accept rotated probe sigs for a 2-hour window post-rotation.
Priya Malhotra: offered 20% service credit while we complete the postmortem; customer accepted.
Sanjay Rao: closing notes: add monitoring alert for sudden increase in "served-region != requested-region" mismatch rate (threshold 0.5% over 5m).
Priya Malhotra: thanks all. Will update ticket and attach postmortem once written. :white_check_mark:
